issue.title: bob periods brief credits every linked task the whole Pomodoro while root rows split it, so tasks outrank their own roots

task_type_fields.impact: Review drafters can't copy per-task minutes without contradicting the root totals. Every bob-cli-gr phase from W41 to W27 left those minutes out.
task_type_fields.repro:
`bob periods brief 2026-W41 -f md` prints the root `sase_blog · 1h 33m (5%)` above its own task `sase_pre_blog#^dynamic-agents-md · 1h 40m`. The gtd_daily task rows add up to more than their root in every week checked: W28 4h 15m + 3h 15m + 2h 15m vs a 6h 30m root; W34 12h 20m vs 7h 11m; W35 8h 00m vs 2h 19m. W30's `sase_better_chops#^bugyi-chops` (1h 15m) is a single session that links 20 tasks.

Root cause: root rows come from the stats `root_parent` lanes, which split a multi-link Pomodoro across its links. Task rows come from `linked_minutes`, which adds the whole `session.counted_minutes()` to every linked task. Fix: split task minutes the same way the lanes do, or label them as unsplit session minutes in the JSON and Markdown.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-gr.3 note #1, re-reported by bob-cli-gr.16 note #1 and bob-cli-gr.17 note #3, and corroborated by most later W40–W27 phases while drafting weekly Reviews from the brief.
